2008 Off-hand Sword.x: 2008 Off-hand Sword is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override. It is unlocked by obtaining the Retro Swords pack.

sc: A Hole in One (beach cocktail) is an item that can be created with an advanced cocktail kit during The Beach events since The Beach in 2021.
As Ironman Mode players cannot obtain advanced cocktail kits, these are limited to normal accounts.
A stylish hat (male, yellow) is obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
Upon receiving a piece from the ringmaster, it becomes available as a cosmetic override in the Customisation interface.
There are six types of hats which may be awarded to players.
Absorption boots can be dropped by Jellies in Daemonheim.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 adamant bars and adamant off hand claws, requiring 800 progress to complete, granting a total of 340 Smithing experience.
The ancient wolf bone amulet is an item obtained during the Wolf Whistle quest.
They can be found rarely while skilling in the Dream of Iaia.
They can only be made by a player with 80 Fletching in groups of 15 from sacred clay (class 5) and wielded by a player with 80 Ranged.
As with all items made in Stealing Creation, they only exist within the minigame and can be traded freely between players who are on the same team during the minigame.
The augmented Achto Primeval robe legs are a level 90 Magic tank legs slot item created by using an augmentor on a pair of Achto Primeval robe legs.
They can be obtained by using an augmentor on the Second-Age range legs.
The Bandos scrimshaw is an ancient artefact available as a drop from revenants in the Forinthry Dungeon.

It was originally a drop from players in PvP worlds and Bounty Hunter worlds to replace certain items that were removed from the drop lists in those worlds (such as the abyssal whip, dragon full helm, and the dragonfire shield).
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 bane bars and a bane full helm + 1, requiring 1,800 progress to complete, granting a total of 2,800 Smithing experience.
After completing the medium Morytania achievements, 13 bat bonemeal and 13 bucket of slime can be obtained daily by giving bat bones to Robin in Port Phasmatys.
A bathus guard is a main-hand necromancy weapon available in Daemonheim.
It can be made using ensouled bathus bars at level 14 Smithing.
Bertha is a page that can be randomly obtained by excavating the Warforge weapon rack and makeshift pie oven excavation hotspots at the Warforge Dig Site.

Brutish Off-hand Dagger was an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the Brutish Melee Weapon Pack.
The bryll orb is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
It can be obtained by using yellow dye on a regular cape, which does not necessarily need to be black.

The glacial siren cloak is a back slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 8 of The Knight Before Christmas.

Green egg.x: A green egg is used in Barbarian Assault to aid teammates. If loaded into the egg launcher, it could be shot at players to restore their run energy and give them a boost depending on their role, boosting attackers' combat stats, giving logs to defenders and filling healers' vials.

sc: Hawthorn's hatchet is received from a special forgotten casket, which is obtained by digging at the spot indicated by a very rare forgotten painting with a red picture of the Shuruk-Ba palace.

The Headsplitter hat is a very rare cosmetic prize that could be won from Squeal of Fortune and Treasure Hunter.
It was also included in the initial inventory of limited rares available from the rare token store.
It can be obtained from beehives west of Catherby and south of Wendlewick or beehives at Manor Farm, by clicking the "Take-honey" option with an insect repellent in the backpack or tool belt.
Insect repellent can be obtained on a table in a small house east of the beehives, south of the archery shop in Catherby.
A huge XP lamp (Fishing) is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter.
It was made by combining a green charm with 109 spirit shards and a Harpoon.

sc: The rainbow parasol is a cosmetic reward from the Rainbow's End Treasure Hunter promotion.
Raven Wings is a wings slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 1,500 H'oddments from the H'oddments Store.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 18 of Count Yakula's Yak Track with the premier pass.
Raw scimitops meat is an item obtained by hunting a scimitops.
To get tier 10 in all of the 12 roles you must obtain 3,878,580 tokens which is equivalent to at least 38,785,800 experience (Level 110).
If the ring of kinship is converted into a role, the roleless version can no longer be obtained inside a dungeon except in F2P worlds.
Ring of riding is a reward item from the 2025 April Fools event.
Once the skill chip was unlocked, no more tomatoes could be obtained.
Sack of large parcels is an item obtained during the Parcels from the Hedge event.
It can be obtained rarely while opening large parcels.
Silver sickles are melee weapons crafted from silver bars.
Silver sickles are the only melee weapons crafted from silver, apart from quest-related weapons like the rod of ivandis, the ivandis flail, and the blisterwood polearm.
Slayer's respite can be made using the brewing vats in eastern Keldagrim or Port Phasmatys.
A slimy eel is a fish that can be caught at level 28 Fishing, granting 65 Fishing experience per catch.
Snow cape is a cape unlocked by using a snow cape token.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
The ability to make the tablet is unlocked with rank 4 reputation in any Menaphos district.
It may then be made from 1 soft clay and 2 law runes at any lectern in a player-owned house.
Soulbound lantern (Blood) is an off-hand Necromancy conduit created by using a Blood dye on the Soulbound lantern.
Spined boots can only be obtained as a drop from ranged dagannoths or through trade.
They can also be given as a reward for completing a farming request from Rhazien.
Only prismatic skill cards could be won from 29 August until 9 September, but previously won cards could be completed until 9 October.
Susy and the other implings can be received through the Gift of Giving or by hunting snow implings.
The Tambourine is obtained through the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distractions and Diversion.
If players lose this item, they can talk to Balthazar Beauregard to obtain it.
It is obtained by restoring its damaged variant obtained during the Tomes of the Warlock quest by talking to Reldo in the Varrock Library.

Third age melee set.x: Third age melee set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: To obtain the Third age robe, the player can either complete hard Treasure Trails for a chance at receiving it, trade with another player, or buy it at the Grand Exchange.
Originally, the bonuses of this robe were equivalent to the Infinity bottoms obtained in the Mage Training Arena, but were later slightly increased.
They are found in one of the jiggling crates inside a ruined building in west Varrock.
A trader summoning stone could be obtained from 23 April to 26 May 2019 by redeeming a bond at a 1:1 ratio, effectively valuing each stone at .
The treasure chest is a reward given to players for completing Carnillean Rising.
Attempting to offer a living creature as a reward for a treasure hunt results in the chat message .
They require level 85 Magic, Defence, and Ranged to be equipped, but not to be obtained.
They may be received after winning a game of Pest Control - an interface will appear from which one of the three hybrid armour boots can be chosen.

The Tuska mask plate is an uncommon drop from airut while on a Slayer task that can be combined with the other four pieces of the mask (headpiece, lower tusks, top, upper tusks) to create the tuska mask, which can be redeemed for combat experience.
War Bunny is a pet that can be purchased for 5 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing task 10 of the Kerapac Track event.
The warlock top is a holiday reward from the 2008 Halloween event.
Players who did not previously obtain a warlock top could get one during the 2025 Halloween event by buying it at the Harvest Boon.
The Wen Neophyte's Halberd is cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 25 of Path of the Creators event with the premier pass.

Wildstalker helmet (tier 6).x: A tier 6 wildstalker helmet is a helmet that keeps track of the amount of kills in the Wilderness of the wearer. Players may claim one from Mr Ex after 5,000 kills.

sc: The green, red and yellow Winter Scarf (referred to as Winter scarf 4 in the tooltip) is a neck slot item that can be purchased for 2,000 Christmas spirit from the Christmas Spirit Shop.
It could originally be obtained by opening Blue Christmas Presents from the 2023 Christmas event.
Wushrooms could be found on Uncharted Isles - sea shells now fill this role.
A zephyrium bar is a bar that can be created by using zephyrium ore on a furnace, requiring level 50 Smithing and granting 38.
The zephyrium ore itself can be mined from the rocks scattered throughout the dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or bought from the Smuggler in the starting room.
They can be bought for 150 zemomarks from Thessalia in New Varrock.
